title: Prepare an Australian household
short: Australian plans, hazards, food and water
intro: Official Australian readings for household preparation, with regional contacts and source dates. This offline library does not receive warnings. South Australian readings retain SA contacts and requirements; they are not national rules.

limits.text: ACMA says mobile emergency calls require coverage from an available mobile network.
Queensland warns that boiling does not make chemically contaminated water safe.
NSW warns against driving, walking or riding through fire or floodwaters.
